fields.iid: Issue identifier; retain as string, not an issuer-level join
fields.isin: Exported ISIN; descriptor history not independently point-in-time verified
fields.datadate: Vendor observation date; parsed ISO date, aligned as Korean local date
fields.fic: Country of incorporation code; not proof of trading venue
fields.exchg: Vendor exchange code; 248 observed for both Korean ISINs; r_ex_codes confirmation pending
fields.tpci: Vendor issue-type code; 0 common and 1 preferred consistent with issuer ISIN mapping; r_issuetyp confirmation pending
fields.prccd: Unadjusted daily closing quote; KRW per share here because qunit=1
fields.qunit: Price quotation unit; per-share price=prccd/qunit; this run requires 1 throughout
fields.ajexdi: Cumulative issue adjustment by ex-date; adjusted price=prccd/qunit/ajexdi. Factor direction checked against issuer 50:1 split; complete vendor action taxonomy pending
fields.prcstd: Daily price-status code. Research-documented convention: 10 prices as reported, 5 last price carried forward; direct vendor r_prc_stat export still required
fields.prchd: Daily high; used only to flag close outside available low/high range
fields.prcld: Daily low; used only to flag close outside available low/high range
fields.cshtrd: Daily trading volume, provisionally shares; require finite positive value as additional trading evidence. Lot/venue conventions need vendor confirmation; not used as a liquidity measure
fields.cshoc: Shares outstanding, provisionally shares; audited but not used in these figures; treasury/economic convention unresolved
fields.split: Exported split event ratio, empirically 50 on both local classes on 2018-05-04; full vendor definition pending
fields.splitf: Split-related field; blank in selected data; definition unresolved, unused
fields.trfd: Daily total-return factor; audited only, unused in price charts; not itself a daily return
fields.curcddv: Dividend currency; event-sparse, not filled or used
fields.divd: Dividend field; event basis and gross/net treatment require vendor documentation; unused
fields.divdgross: Gross dividend field; event basis requires documentation; unused
fields.divdnet: Net dividend field; tax and event basis require documentation; unused
fields.divsp: Special dividend field; unused; missing does not establish zero
fields.anncdate: Exported announcement date; event attribution and availability coverage unverified; unused
fields.divsppaydate: Exported special dividend payment date; unused

sources.evidence: Issuer maps common 005930 to KR7005930003 and preferred 005935 to KR7005931001; both original shares on KRX. Current page does not verify historical vendor identifiers.

Issuer update specifies 50:1 split for both classes, planned suspension April 30 and May 2-3, May 1 nontrading, and new shares trading May 4. Describes preferred as nonvoting and noncumulative, with additional annual cash dividend based on 1% of face value; full historical rights audit remains open.
